biome_census_vs_canon.detail: canon.yml planet.biome_tile_counts is stamped 're-derived 2026-08-23', four days before the 2026-09-07 rebase that replaced the lineage. It says biomes_on_map 28 (measured 29); Desert 4648/ExtremeDesert 3214/Wasteland 1721 (measured 2390/3969/1853); has no row for RUT_TheScald 312, RUT_TwilightSea 607, RUT_GreySea 472, RUT_BlueDesert 1029, RUT_NightsideIce 1506, RUT_PropaneLake 57; and carries Ocean 823/Lake 312/SeaIce 277/IceSheet 80 which are all now 0. rain_mm.max 1668 vs measured 1529. The RULED values in the block (habitable_ring_arc, name, substellar, lapse_c_per_km) are not in question.

named_regions.check: MEASURED-ok on count, MISMATCH on names
named_regions.detail: 71 WorldFeature elements in the save; 71 distinct names in the CSV region column; every tile attributed. But 809 tiles carry a different NAME. 775 are five clean 1:1 renames the CSV never received - South Crags->Sootreach 433, Level->Knuckles 141, Venom Wood->Fuelmere 72, Coldshelf->Sunshelf 68, Thornend->Frostvein 61. The other 34 are a real boundary change: a new region 'The Abandoned Mines' carved from Ashfall Range (22) and Notch (12) - the same two regions frozen.json already flags as the only non-matching pair at the rebase. LOW SEVERITY: region is not an engine field (frozen.json engineFieldsOnly); the shipped world is correct, the record is not. canon.yml named_regions=24 is a DIFFERENT question (meta.json design regions) and is not a mismatch.

settlements.detail: 96 Settlement world objects, 96 of 96 carrying a non-empty nameInt - no unnamed stragglers. Also 20 Site, 37 BasicAsteroidMapParent, 40 DeepOrbit.BigAsteroidMapParent, 3 IceAsteroidMapParent. No CSV counterpart to cross-check against.

landmarks.detail: 3414 landmarks across 65 distinct LandmarkDefs (V24 held 2880). Save-side only; no CSV counterpart.

roads.detail: 1235 road edges over 762 distinct origin tiles: DirtRoad 527, DirtPath 314, StoneRoad 287, AncientAsphaltHighway 107. The tiles CSV has no road column, so this is uncontradicted rather than cross-checked.

river_tiles.detail: Offline: 326 river edges over 217 distinct ORIGIN tiles (Creek 170, River 62, HugeRiver 51, LargeRiver 43); CSV river_flow non-zero on 298 tiles. canon.yml asserts rivers_tiles 254 and carries NO _src - the only planet figure in the block with no provenance. None of 326/217/298 is 254. The engine's 'tiles with a river' is origins union adjacency, and tileRiverAdjacencyDeflate stores a NEIGHBOUR INDEX, not a tile id; resolving it needs the icosphere topology the engine builds at runtime. Not guessed. Needs one jawa/world_* read, which should also finally give rivers_tiles a citation.

shorthash_table_provenance.detail: The def dump is 577 mods (2026-09-10); CANONICAL declares 573 and V24 declares 589. Not the same mod set, and the skill requires that it be. Evidence FOR the reading: all 29 distinct biome hashes resolved, 0 unknown, and the resolved names matched the CSV on 21872/21872 tiles - an outcome a drifted table cannot plausibly produce, since hash drift moves a whole biome wholesale. Evidence AGAINST treating it as settled: agreement is not proof when a failure mode could be shared. The biome reading is MEASURED; the GUARANTEE is not. A dump captured against the canonical mod list closes it.

loads_clean.detail: Nothing offline can see 'Could not load reference to' Scribe errors, mutator legality, or landmark validity. Needs a live load.

mutators.detail: 27870 (tile, def) pairs present in tileMutatorTilesDeflate/tileMutatorDefsDeflate, deliberately not decoded: the tiles CSV has no mutator column, so there is nothing offline to verify them against. world/ASHKARR_WORLDMAP_mutators.csv is a separate artifact with its own currency question.

summary.verdict: The shipped planet and the frozen record are the same planet. Every field the engine reads agrees on all 21872 tiles against CANONICAL_ASHKARR_2026-09-09.rws, and the freeze hash is current. Both mismatches are bookkeeping, not world state.
